description: Live pilot baseline recorded post-SCRUM-558 (session_metadata RAG feature shipped). Captures end-to-end SessionAsk + judge + aggregate report metrics on the 28-case inventory (FF-001..FF-028). FF-025..FF-028 exercise the new session_metadata source_type. Refresh on any subsequent case retirement, judge-model swap, scorer change, or RAG-pipeline change.
limitations: Run artifacts under eval/qa/runs/ are gitignored; baseline metrics are captured here from report.json.
Live run quality depends on auth/session setup, OpenAI availability, indexing latency, and external network conditions.

Judge/answerer variance can produce sporadic single-case failures even with answerer + judge at temperature=0 (observed in run 1 of this session, scrum558-post-merge-baseline-20260522-1550: FF-010 returned malformed answer_status and was graded as a hallucination). Treat single-run overall_pass=false on a previously-passing case as a flake unless reproduced; the SCRUM-558 rerun was clean 28/28.
